build_compose_transforms: build a Compose transform to chain multiple data preprocessing transforms together in sequence
create_dense_normalization: create a DenseNormalization transform to normalize dense feature tensors using normalization data and presence masks
build_id_list_features: build an IDListFeatures transform to convert sparse multi-category ID list data into KeyedJaggedTensor format
create_one_hot_actions: create a OneHotActions transform to convert integer action indices into one-hot encoded tensors
build_cat_transform: build a Cat transform to concatenate multiple tensors along a specified dimension with optional broadcasting
